GMR Aero Technic signs Honeywell MRO licence agreement

GMR Aero Technic signed a licence agreement with Honeywell Aerospace on 28 July 2026 for Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul services in Hyderabad, India. The agreement covers seven Honeywell Aerospace Line Replaceable Units installed on LEAP engines used in commercial aviation.

Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul

Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul, or MRO, is an aviation support activity that includes inspection, repair, overhaul, and restoration of aircraft components and systems. In aviation, depot-level maintenance refers to deeper repair work carried out at specialised facilities rather than at the aircraft line station.

LEAP Engines and Line Replaceable Units

LEAP is a family of turbofan engines developed by CFM International for narrow-body aircraft. The engine powers the Airbus A320neo and Boeing 737 MAX, which are among the most widely used single-aisle aircraft in global airline fleets. Line Replaceable Units are modular aircraft components that can be removed and replaced quickly during maintenance.

India’s Aviation MRO Ecosystem

Hyderabad is one of India’s aviation engineering centres and hosts GMR Aero Technic’s repair infrastructure. The agreement adds in-region repair capability for LEAP engine operators in India and nearby markets. It also aligns with the Make in India initiative, which is a Government of India programme launched in 2014 to expand domestic manufacturing and technical capability.

Important Facts for Exams Honeywell Aerospace is a division of Honeywell International and supplies avionics, engines, and aerospace systems. Airbus A320neo and Boeing 737 MAX belong to the narrow-body commercial aircraft segment. Depot-level maintenance is more complex than line maintenance and usually requires specialised tooling and facilities. India has promoted domestic MRO capacity to reduce dependence on overseas aircraft maintenance hubs.

Commercial aviation MRO services are classified into line maintenance, base maintenance, component repair, and engine overhaul. Component MRO for LRUs is a key part of aircraft support because it helps airlines manage spare parts, service time, and fleet availability.

AstraZeneca India to Sets Up Genomic Solutions Centre in Amaravati

AstraZeneca India announced an Integrated Genomic Solutions Centre in Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh, on 28 July 2026. The centre is part of India’s first Integrated Precision Oncology programme and focuses on genetic research for cancer diagnosis and therapy.

Integrated Precision Oncology

Precision oncology is a cancer treatment approach that uses genetic and molecular information to match diagnosis and therapy with a patient’s disease profile. Integrated genomic centres use next-generation genetic testing, bioinformatics, and clinical data for cancer screening and treatment planning.

Focus Areas in Cancer Care

The centre will primarily target lung cancer and breast cancer. These two cancers are among the most commonly diagnosed malignancies in India and are major areas of screening, early detection, and treatment research.

Technology and Hospital Screening

The initiative includes AI-powered X-rays and next-generation genetic testing for use in government hospitals. AstraZeneca India is working with Strand Life Sciences and Qure.ai to deploy smart screening tools for earlier diagnosis and improved patient management.

Important Facts for Exams Amaravati is the planned capital region of Andhra Pradesh. Precision medicine uses biological data, including genetic information, for disease management. Indian Railways Approves ₹163 Crore Traction Upgrade for Parbhani-Mudkhed

Indian Railways sanctioned a ₹163 crore project on 28 July 2026 for the upgradation of the electric traction system on the Parbhani-Mudkhed double line section. The section falls under the Nanded Division of the South Central Railway and covers 164 track kilometres.

Electric Traction System

Electric traction is the use of electric power for train movement through overhead equipment and substations. The existing 1×25 kV system on the Parbhani-Mudkhed section will be converted to a 2×25 kV system, which is used on high-density railway corridors.

Project Scope and Technical Features

The project includes electric traction upgradation and associated power supply installation works. The 2×25 kV system uses a higher voltage arrangement for better power transmission over long stretches of railway track. Such systems are used to support heavier train loads and higher traffic density on double line sections.

Route Significance and Railway Network

The Parbhani-Mudkhed section forms part of Highly Utilised Network Route-9. This route connects major railway points such as Ajmer, Indore, Secunderabad, and Dhone. The section is placed on a corridor that handles both passenger and freight movement within the South Central Railway zone.

Important Facts for Exams Indian Railways was established in 1853, and it remains one of the largest railway networks in the world by route length. South Central Railway is one of the 18 railway zones of Indian Railways. Vande Bharat Express is an indigenous semi-high-speed train service operated by Indian Railways. Indian Railways has set a freight loading target of 3,000 million tonnes by 2029-30.

title: China Completes Testing of World’s Largest Fusion Magnet
category: Current Affairs Today - Latest Current Affairs - 2026-2027
content:
Home

China Completes Testing of World’s Largest Fusion Magnet

China completed expert acceptance and full-parameter testing of two domestically developed superconducting magnets on 27 June 2026 at the Institute of Plasma Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences, in Hefei, Anhui Province. The tested systems were a toroidal field superconducting magnet and a high-temperature superconducting central solenoid coil for fusion research.

Fusion Magnet Systems

The toroidal field superconducting magnet is a D-shaped structure that measures 21 metres in length, 12 metres in width, and 582 tonnes in weight. It is described as the largest fusion reactor superconducting magnet built so far. The toroidal field magnet is used to confine plasma inside a vacuum chamber with a strong magnetic field. In fusion devices, plasma is heated to about 100 million degrees Celsius and must remain stable for controlled operation.

Central Solenoid Coil and Fusion Control

The high-temperature superconducting central solenoid coil was also tested during the same exercise. In a fusion reactor, the central solenoid coil induces and drives plasma current, which is a core function in ignition and stable operation. Both magnet systems reached internationally leading performance levels during testing. The central solenoid coil is part of the magnetic system used in tokamak-type fusion devices.

Domestic Manufacturing and CRAFT Project

Both magnet systems achieved 100% domestic production across the supply chain, including core raw materials and fabrication processes. The project is linked to the Comprehensive Research Facility for Fusion Technology, or CRAFT, which is part of China’s “artificial sun” programme. The toroidal field magnet has 1.3 times the volume and three times the stored energy of comparable magnets used in the International Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor, or ITER. China has set a target of fusion power generation around 2030.

Important Facts for Exams Fusion is the process of combining light atomic nuclei to release energy, and it powers the Sun and other stars. Tokamak is a magnetic confinement device used in fusion research, and it uses toroidal geometry. Superconducting magnets can carry electric current with very low resistance when cooled to extremely low temperatures. ITER is an international fusion energy project based in France.

Fusion is the process of combining light atomic nuclei to release energy, and it powers the Sun and other stars.

Raksha Mantri Announces Indian Coast Guard Policy Reforms

On 28 July 2026, Raksha Mantri Rajnath Singh announced two policy reforms for the Indian Coast Guard at Kartavya Bhavan-2 in New Delhi. The reforms cover gender-neutral induction and service conditions for officers, and administrative procedures for ex-gratia support to families of personnel missing at sea while on duty.

Indian Coast Guard

The Indian Coast Guard is a maritime armed force under the Ministry of Defence. It was established in 1977 and functions under the Coast Guard Act, 1978. Its core duties include maritime law enforcement, search and rescue, marine environment protection, and assistance to the Indian Navy during wartime.

Gender-Neutral Induction Policy

The new framework allows women candidates to be inducted into both Short Service Appointments and Permanent Appointments on the same terms as male candidates. Short Service Appointments are time-bound commissions, while Permanent Appointments provide a longer career structure in uniformed service. The policy also provides equal career progression opportunities for women officers from the initial training stage. Women officers already serving on Short Service Appointments can opt for conversion to Permanent Appointment, subject to prescribed conditions.

Ex-Gratia Procedure for Missing Personnel

The second reform simplifies administrative procedures for granting ex-gratia to families of Indian Coast Guard personnel reported missing at sea while on duty. Ex-gratia is a financial assistance payment made by the government in specific cases, including service-related deaths or missing personnel, under applicable rules. The announcement was made in the presence of Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh and Director General of the Indian Coast Guard Paramesh Sivamani. The Indian Coast Guard operates along India’s coastline, exclusive economic zone, and island territories.

Important Facts for Exams The Indian Coast Guard was established in 1977 and came under the Coast Guard Act, 1978. The Indian Coast Guard functions under the Ministry of Defence. Short Service Appointments are limited-term commissions, while Permanent Appointments are career-long service structures. Ex-gratia is a discretionary financial relief provided by the government in specified cases.

title: New Fungus Species Named After Kolhapur
category: Current Affairs Today - Latest Current Affairs - 2026-2027
content:

New Fungus Species Named After Kolhapur

A new polypore fungus species, Microporellus kolhapurensis, was discovered in Bhudargad taluka of Kolhapur district on 27 July 2026. The species was found on rotting wood in the Bediv area on the Ajra border of Bhudargad taluka and was named after Kolhapur.

Discovery and Taxonomy

Microporellus kolhapurensis belongs to the polypore, or bracket fungus, group. Polypores are fungi that usually grow on wood and produce pores on the underside of the fruiting body. The species was identified by Dr Anjali Patil, head of the botany department at Rajaram College, and research scholar Yogesh Patil.

Habitat and Feeding Pattern

The fungus was collected from decaying wood, which is a common substrate for saprotrophic fungi. Saprotrophic fungi obtain nutrition by breaking down dead organic matter, and they play a role in decomposition and nutrient recycling in forest ecosystems. The ground-growing habit of the species places it among wood-decaying fungi that are often studied in forest biodiversity surveys.

Key Morphological Features

The species has a yellowish-orange to greyish-brown, umbrella-shaped fruiting body with a lateral stalk. It also has large pores, teardrop-shaped spores, and thick-walled cystidia. These characters are used in fungal taxonomy for species identification and comparison with related taxa.

Important Facts for Exams Polypore fungi are also called bracket fungi because many species form shelf-like fruiting bodies on wood. Saprotrophic fungi are decomposers that break down dead plant material and return nutrients to the soil. The genus Microporellus has about 36 recognised species globally. Microporellus obovatus was the only species of this genus previously recorded from Maharashtra.

Important Facts for Exams

Polypore fungi are also called bracket fungi because many species form shelf-like fruiting bodies on wood.

Saprotrophic fungi are decomposers that break down dead plant material and return nutrients to the soil.

Publication and Biodiversity Context

The research findings were published in Nelumbo, the research journal of the Botanical Survey of India. The discovery adds to the documented fungal diversity of Kolhapur district and Maharashtra. Fungal species descriptions usually include habitat, spore shape, pore structure, and cystidia as standard taxonomic characters.

CWG 2026: Valluri Ajaya Babu wins silver in men’s 79kg weightlifting

Valluri Ajaya Babu is an Indian weightlifter from Andhra Pradesh who won the silver medal in the men’s 79kg category at the Commonwealth Games 2026 in Glasgow, Scotland, on 27 July 2026. He lifted a total of 330kg, with 149kg in the snatch and 181kg in the clean and jerk.

Weightlifting Event Format

Olympic-style weightlifting has two competitive lifts, the snatch and the clean and jerk. The total score is the sum of the best successful lift in each discipline, and medals are awarded on the basis of the combined total in a weight category.

Commonwealth Games Weightlifting

Weightlifting has been a regular medal sport at the Commonwealth Games, which is a multi-sport event for athletes from the Commonwealth of Nations. The men’s 79kg class is one of the bodyweight categories used in international weightlifting competitions under the International Weightlifting Federation framework.

Career Record and Family Background

Ajaya Babu set a Commonwealth Games record in the snatch with 149kg during the 2026 event. He finished one kilogram behind Malaysia’s Erry Hidayat Muhammad, who won gold with a Games record total of 331kg. His father, Valluri Srinivasa Rao, won a bronze medal at the 2010 Commonwealth Games in Delhi.

Valluri Ajaya Babu was born on 25 November 2004 in Kondavelagada village, Vizianagaram district, Andhra Pradesh . ANNAM.AI Smart Weather Stations Deployed in Kerala

Kerala has begun integrating ANNAM.AI smart weather stations under its 100-day action plan for climate-smart agriculture as of 28 July 2026. The stations use artificial intelligence to provide hyper-local weather and farm data for decision-making at the field level.

ANNAM.AI and Digital Public Infrastructure for Agriculture

ANNAM.AI is a Centre of Excellence for Artificial Intelligence in Agriculture at IIT Ropar, which functions with support from the Ministry of Education. The project is developing a digital public infrastructure for agriculture, a term used for shared digital systems that support public service delivery and data-based applications. The smart weather stations provide information at a 3-kilometre resolution. The system tracks solar radiation, soil moisture, wind patterns, humidity, and rainfall for agricultural use.

Climate-Smart Farming Applications

Climate-smart agriculture is an approach that uses data, technology, and resource management to support crop production under variable weather conditions. In Kerala , the deployment is linked to crop yield improvement, loss reduction, resource optimisation, and lower operational costs. Kerala’s farm structure includes a high share of small holdings, with about 92% of farms measuring less than one hectare. Such fragmented holdings create a need for localised weather information and precision farming tools.

Rollout, Training, and Partnerships

The Kerala deployment is part of a phased rollout across Indian states. Punjab was identified as the first implementation location for 100 AI-powered weather stations by 30 March 2026. ANNAM.AI plans to train 10,000 students, rural youth, and agriculture professionals in the use of AI applications in agriculture. A partnership between ANNAM.AI at IIT Ropar and Syngenta was unveiled at Bharat Innovates 2026 in France in June 2026 for crop health monitoring, pest outbreak tracking, and heat-stress management.

Important Facts for Exams IIT Ropar is an Indian Institute of Technology located in Punjab. Artificial intelligence in agriculture is used for crop monitoring, weather analysis, and input management. Internet of Things devices in farming collect field data through connected sensors and stations. Kerala has a large share of small and marginal farms, which makes local weather data important for agriculture.

Sharmila Dhankar Wins CWG 2026 Shot Put Gold

Sharmila Dhankar won the gold medal in the women’s F57 shot put event at the Commonwealth Games 2026 in Glasgow on 27 July 2026. She recorded a season-best throw of 9.81 metres. Her victory ended India’s 20-year wait for a para athletics medal at the Commonwealth Games , with India’s previous medal in this category dating to 2006.

Women’s F57 Shot Put

The F57 class in para athletics includes athletes with lower limb impairments, limb deficiencies, or reduced muscle power. The event is part of field athletics and uses a seated throwing frame for athletes in the F57 category.

Indian Double Podium Finish

Shilpa K Shyla won the bronze medal in the same event after Nigeria’s Eucharia Iyiazi was disqualified following an official review. This was India’s first double podium finish in a para athletics event at the Commonwealth Games.

Commonwealth Games 2026 Medal Context

India collected six medals on Day 5 of CWG 2026 across para athletics, weightlifting, and athletics. By 28 July 2026, India’s medal tally stood at 10, with two gold, five silver, and three bronze medals.

title: Made-in-Bharat chips for space rockets announced
category: Current Affairs Today - Latest Current Affairs - 2026-2027

Made-in-Bharat chips for space rockets announced

India is set to use domestically produced semiconductors in space launch vehicles after an announcement by Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw on 27 July 2026. The development follows a meeting with Skyroot Aerospace after the Vikram-1 Test Flight-1 reached orbit, making it India’s first privately developed orbital-class rocket.

Semiconductors in space launch vehicles

Semiconductors are electronic materials used in chips, controllers, and onboard systems in rockets and satellites. Space launch vehicles require chips that can function under vibration, radiation, temperature variation, and vacuum conditions.

Indian space chip development

In March 2026, the Indian Space Research Organisation announced a plan to produce its own semiconductors within four years. India’s space electronics work includes processors, controllers, and mission-specific hardware for launch vehicles and spacecraft.

VIKRAM3201 and related processors

At Semicon India 2025 in September 2025, India’s first fully indigenous 32-bit microprocessor, VIKRAM3201, was presented to Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The chip was developed by the Semi-conductor Laboratory and the Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre, and it was validated in space on the PSLV Orbital Experimental Module-4 in the PSLV-C60 mission. VIKRAM3201 is designed for the harsh conditions of space launch vehicles. It is a successor to the 16-bit Vikram1601, which has been used in ISRO launch vehicles since 2009.

Other indigenous space chips

In February 2025, IIT Madras and ISRO developed the Indigenous RISCV Controller for Space Applications, or IRIS , for command and control systems and other critical space functions. Another 32-bit microprocessor, KALPANA3201, was also developed for launch vehicle applications and was designed to work with open-source software toolsets.

Important Facts for Exams Skyroot Aerospace became India’s first privately developed orbital-class rocket company after Vikram-1 Test Flight-1 reached orbit. VIKRAM3201 is a 32-bit microprocessor, while Vikram1601 is a 16-bit processor used since 2009. PSLV-C60 carried the PSLV Orbital Experimental Module-4, where VIKRAM3201 was validated in space. IRIS stands for Indigenous RISCV Controller for Space Applications and is based on the SHAKTI processor baseline.

Launch vehicle electronics

Launch vehicle electronics include guidance systems, telemetry units, onboard computers, and control processors. India’s space hardware ecosystem includes ISRO, the Semi-conductor Laboratory, the Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre, IIT Madras, and private firms such as Skyroot Aerospace.

title: Government proposes three-year PUC validity for BS-VI vehicles
category: Current Affairs Today - Latest Current Affairs - 2026-2027

Government proposes three-year PUC validity for BS-VI vehicles

The Union government proposed a revised validity period for the Pollution Under Control Certificate (PUCC) for BS-VI-compliant private vehicles on 27 July 2026. The draft notification was issued by the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) under the PUCC 3.0 plan.

Pollution Under Control Certificate

The Pollution Under Control Certificate is a statutory document issued after an emission test for motor vehicles in India. It is linked to the Motor Vehicles Act framework and is used to check compliance with prescribed emission limits.

Proposed validity for private vehicles

Under the draft rules, BS-VI private vehicles up to six years old will have a PUCC validity of three years. BS-VI private vehicles between six and ten years old will require annual renewal, and BS-VI private vehicles older than 10 years will need renewal every six months.

Proposed validity for transport vehicles and older emission standards

For BS-VI transport or commercial vehicles, the proposed PUCC validity for vehicles up to six years old is two years from the date of first registration. BS-IV vehicles will continue to require renewal every six months, while BS-I, BS-II and BS-III vehicles will need renewal every three months.

Important Facts for Exams BS-VI refers to Bharat Stage VI, India’s sixth-stage vehicular emission standard. BS-VI norms came into force nationwide in India from 1 April 2020 for new vehicles. PUCC stands for Pollution Under Control Certificate. MoRTH is the Union ministry responsible for road transport, highways and motor vehicle rules in India.

Important Facts for Exams

BS-VI refers to Bharat Stage VI, India’s sixth-stage vehicular emission standard.

BS-VI norms came into force nationwide in India from 1 April 2020 for new vehicles.

Draft rule process

Objections and suggestions on the draft notification may be submitted within 30 days from the date the notification is made available to the public. The final rules will be considered after this consultation period.

Telangana Launches Family Register Initiative

Telangana issued G.O.Ms. No. 172 on 25 July 2026 to create a statewide electronic Family Register and to introduce the Family Register Certificate as a citizen service on the MeeSeva platform. The register will use data mainly from the Food Security Card database maintained by the Civil Supplies Department.

Family Register Certificate

The Family Register Certificate is a document linked to family composition and is intended for citizens, especially Food Security Card holders. The register will record names, relationship to the head of the family, age, date of birth, gender, Aadhaar number, and present address.

Identification and Application Process

Each family unit will receive a Family Register Identification Number, and this number will be the same as the ration card number. A major member of the family can apply for the certificate through MeeSeva centres, the online portal, or the mobile application, and the prescribed service charge is ₹62.

Processing Time and Legal Status

Applications for the Family Register Certificate are expected to be processed and delivered within two working days from the date of receipt. The government order states that the certificate does not create, extinguish, or determine any right, title, or interest in property, and it does not determine legal heirship or confer rights to claim government scheme benefits.

Important Facts for Exams MeeSeva is a citizen service delivery platform used in Telangana for government-to-citizen services. Food Security Cards are commonly known as ration cards in India and are linked to public distribution records. Aadhaar is a 12-digit unique identity number issued under the Aadhaar Act, 2016. Special Intensive Revision is a process used for updating electoral rolls in India.

Important Facts for Exams

Political and Administrative Context

AIMIM president and Hyderabad MP Asaduddin Owaisi and Telangana government advisor Mohammed Ali Shabbir welcomed the initiative. The BJP alleged that the initiative was intended to protect illegal vote banks.
